value.rationale: The regular truncated tetrahedron is a canonical 12-direction Archimedean sampling set with applications to angular data. The theorem completely classifies exact-degree harmonic interpolation for all degrees, including a nonmonotone three-dimensional degree-six defect, a sharp persistent degree-seven threshold, and an isolated resonance under natural geometric truncation. This is a meaningful complete natural invariant rather than a small arbitrary matrix computation; no downstream theorem is needed.
